title: Vegetarian Tagine Belle Epoque
description: Inspired by the flavors of Tunisia, this hearty vegetarian tagine is a delicious twist on traditional North African cuisine.
instructions: Heat the coconut oil in a large clay or ceramic tagine over medium heat.
Add the ginger and cook, stirring occasionally, until fragrant, 4-5 minutes.
Add the bell peppers and carrots and cook, stirring occasionally, until they begin to soften, 5 minutes.
Add the cumin, paprika, salt, and cinnamon and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the olives, apricots, and enough water to cover the ingredients. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, until the vegetables are tender, 20-25 minutes.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro, if desired.
